notes.f2: Not recovered, and the miss is an attachment to the wrong record rather than a blank. The tree carries S1 from the right collection -- "Norway, Marriages, 1660-1926" -- but at ark 1:1:NW4M-XZF, "Entry for Anders Monsen Roesland". The expected 1:1:NW44-PM2 appears zero times in research.json; NW4M-XZF appears nineteen. The 87 assertions drawn from it describe a man born 1853 who married 14 June 1896 at Bergen, son of Mons Endresen Roesland and Karine Eriksdatter -- a different person a hundred and ten years later. S1 is referenced once in the tree and not on the subject, so the wrong marriage was at least not asserted of Anders Monsen. The run also minted six stubs, I1 to I6, from three separate 1865 census households at Kinsarvik and Ulvik, each carrying a person_evidence link at probable with match_score null; those are eighty years after the marriage and in other parishes.
